_comment2: DefaultLabels uses triage/untriaged because it already exists in unoplatform/uno and matches its prefix/name convention. The issue body already states Source: Discord, so no extra provenance label is needed.
_comment: Copy the non-secret parts into appsettings.json. Secrets go in user-secrets (local) or environment variables (Discord__Token, GitHub__Auth__PrivateKeyPem). Never commit them.

Auth._InstallationId: Optional. Leave out and the bridge finds it from Owner/Repository, then logs it at startup.
Auth.PrivateKeyPath: <path to the GitHub App .pem, or set GitHub__Auth__PrivateKeyPem>
